1.title: Trump Brings Full Weight of Government to Bolster False Election Claims
1.summary: Intelligence agencies provided the White House with a trove of declassified documents that President Trump cited on Thursday as evidence of election vulnerabilities.

2.title: At least two dead in Texas floods ravaging same area where campers died
2.summary: The same area devastated by floods last year's floods, which caused more than 130 deaths, is once again being hit.

3.title: Judges Ask Congress for Power to Fix Crumbling Courthouses
3.summary: Undrinkable water. Leaks. Mold. Federal courthouses need billions of dollars in repairs, and judges say the General Services Administration is a bad landlord.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. Hits Bridges and a Port in Country’s South, Iranian Media says
4.summary: The U.S. military’s Central Command said the latest round of attacks had “hit dozens of Iranian military targets” but made no mention of civilian infrastructure.

5.title: Andy Burnham Becomes Labour Leader and Is Set to Be Britain’s Prime Minister
5.summary: Mr. Burnham promised more public control of essential services, a shift of power toward local governments and a push for economic growth.

6.title: Venezuela Earthquakes Force a Grim Homecoming for Migrants
6.summary: Mass migration, which defines modern Venezuela, has heavily marked the earthquake, too, saving many who had left, but also making their grief harder.
